description: This file contains classes and functions for handling XML schemas related to database structure, including schema parsing, conversion, and SQL generation for database objects like tables, indexes, and data. It is part of the ADOdb library for PHP, supporting schema creation, upgrade, and removal via XML definitions.

classes.name: adoSchema
classes.description: Main class for loading, parsing, converting, and executing XML database schemas, supporting schema versioning, inline execution, and schema transformation.

classes.name: dbObject
classes.description: Abstract base class providing common methods for database objects such as tables and indexes, including platform support and prefix handling.

classes.name: dbTable
classes.description: Represents a database table, with methods for adding fields, indexes, data, generating SQL, and managing table schema.

classes.name: dbIndex
classes.description: Represents a database index, with methods for adding fields, options, generating SQL, and marking for deletion.

classes.name: dbData
classes.description: Represents table data, with methods for parsing XML data rows, adding fields, and generating insert SQL statements.

classes.name: dbQuerySet
classes.description: Handles a set of SQL queries, supporting building, prefixing, and executing queries from XML schema definitions.

methods.name: SetUpgradeMethod
methods.description: Sets the method for upgrading existing database objects (ALTER, REPLACE, etc.).

methods.name: ExecuteInline
methods.description: Enables or disables inline execution of SQL statements as they are generated.

methods.name: ContinueOnError
methods.description: Enables or disables continuing schema execution upon encountering errors.

methods.name: ParseSchema
methods.description: Loads an XML schema file and converts it into SQL statements.

methods.name: ParseSchemaString
methods.description: Parses an XML schema string into SQL statements.

methods.name: RemoveSchema
methods.description: Loads a schema file and generates SQL to remove the described database objects.

methods.name: RemoveSchemaString
methods.description: Converts a schema string into SQL for uninstallation.

methods.name: ExecuteSchema
methods.description: Executes the SQL statements generated from schema parsing to create or modify the database.

methods.name: PrintSQL
methods.description: Returns the SQL statements as a string or array in specified format.

methods.name: SaveSQL
methods.description: Saves the generated SQL statements to a file.

methods.name: create_parser
methods.description: Creates an XML parser with callback handlers.

methods.name: _tag_open
methods.description: Handles start XML tags during parsing.

methods.name: _tag_cdata
methods.description: Handles character data inside XML elements.

methods.name: _tag_close
methods.description: Handles end XML tags during parsing.

methods.name: ConvertSchemaString
methods.description: Converts an XML schema string to a different DTD version, optionally saving to file.

methods.name: ConvertSchemaFile
methods.description: Converts an XML schema file to a different DTD version, optionally saving to file.

methods.name: TransformSchema
methods.description: Transforms schema XML using XSLT to convert versions.

methods.name: xslt_error_handler
methods.description: Handles errors during XSLT transformation.

methods.name: SchemaFileVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the schema version from a schema file.

methods.name: SchemaStringVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the schema version from a schema string.

methods.name: ExtractSchema
methods.description: Generates an XML schema from an existing database, optionally including data.

methods.name: SetPrefix
methods.description: Sets a prefix for database objects in schema parsing.

methods.name: prefix
methods.description: Returns an object name with the current prefix prepended.

methods.name: supportedPlatform
methods.description: Checks if a platform is supported for a database object.

methods.name: clearSQL
methods.description: Clears the stored SQL statements array.

methods.name: addSQL
methods.description: Adds SQL statements to the internal array, optionally executing inline.

methods.name: getSQL
methods.description: Returns stored SQL in specified format.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Cleans up the schema object (deprecated).

methods.name: logMsg
methods.description: Logs messages if debugging is enabled.
